assistant.offStepConfig: The easiest: add a key in “AI providers” (AI menu).
assistant.offStepEnv: Or, for a site configured by file, set COGENTA_LLM_API_KEY (with COGENTA_LLM_PROVIDER and COGENTA_LLM_MODEL) in the environment.
assistant.vectorIndexedBeforeStart: Last indexed: before the site last started.
assistant.usageNoLimit: {{tokens}} tokens used this month. No cap configured.

assistantIndex.reindexError: The index could not be rebuilt.
assistantIndex.emptyIndex: The index is empty: the assistant finds nothing and duplicate detection sees no resemblance. Run “Reindex the content” to fill it with what is already published.
assistantIndex.removeBody: The document leaves the index: the assistant can no longer use or cite it. To put it back, upload it again.
assistantIndex.reindexHint: Turning a collection off leaves it out of future saves. What was already indexed stays until the next reindex: “Reindex the content” puts the index right in one go, published content and included or excluded collections alike.
assistantIndex.heading: Knowledge index
